A.package: Package filed: design_report.html, borehole_log.html, scour_calculation.html, compliance_statement.html. All required documents included and comply with IRC:78 Clause 703.3.1. Ready for review.

B.note: The design report and geotechnical investigation indicate that the foundation soil consists of loose sand susceptible to scour, and IRC:78 clause 703.3.1 requires a scour computation for the design flood with protection works dimensioned accordingly. The package contains only a placeholder for the scour assessment (Appendix D.4) and no actual scour calculation or protection dimensions. Consequently, the submission does not satisfy the design standard. The finding is flagged for the reviewer to obtain the required scour computation before opening the bridge to traffic.
